edit.description: synthesize the counsel rule beside withGuidanceRules' kind rules, under the reserved temper prefix
the program gets its counsel rule
re-emit: the synthesized rule (name is build's call)

summary: emit synthesizes a path-scoped rule over the program's own modules (.temper/**) carrying the SDK's authoring counsel
acceptance: every emitted represented harness carries one temper-owned rule scoped to its program directory whose body is the SDK counsel constant (about 1k tokens at most); an authored rule at that name refuses; SDK gate green
notes: Synthesized, not install-scaffolded: a scaffolded copy goes stale on SDK upgrade, a second spelling (authoring.md, One fact, one spelling); emit re-projects it, as 0091 does kind guidance. Name must not collide with temper-guidance-<kind>. Seeds: gateHook over hook()+command, required: false on advisory requirements.
